# TextFold parsing subset

Source: https://github.com/chenxiachan/textfold

Pinned commit: `2cd77e0987b590f9f67154bcdda76c59e6870b73` (TextFold 0.10.7).

These unmodified modules parse Markdown, sanitize HTML, retain figures/tables/math and tokenize source paragraphs. Only the local, extractive ladder is used by `scripts/textfold_sources.py`; no upstream model/provider/server code is included. LICENSE and NOTICE apply. Frontend assets have their own notice in `site/vendor/textfold/`.
